headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high-flyers and modest leaders.
summary: Revenue growth ranged from sub‑2% at Infosys to over 50% at Coforge. Profit margins improved for most firms, driven by AI‑related deals. Guidance was trimmed at Infosys but raised at Coforge. Headcount expansion continued at HCLTech while Wipro saw a headcount decline.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms reported double‑digit AI revenue growth, boosting margins and deal wins.

themes.title: Margin pressure at low‑growth peers
themes.detail: Infosys trimmed FY27 revenue guidance as growth slowed, while Wipro posted a profit decline.

leaders.why: 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised EBIT margin guidance to 16%

laggards.why: Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and guidance cut
